status: CANDIDATE (not frozen for production; frozen copies are written into each training release root)
supersedes: nothing: rind3d-production-contract-v0.2 (data generation) stays frozen and in force; this contract adds the training layer on top of it

base_contracts.v0.1_lite_1k: rind3d-lite-v0.1 (restricted campaign lite-core-1k-v01; public snapshot RIND3D-v0.1)

semantics.world: [0,1]^3, resolution 1024, receivers at voxel centres (i + 1/2)/1024, arrays ZYX, packed bits little-endian along X
semantics.visibility: closed segment source-receiver; contact blocks; SOLID receivers have response 0 and are not FREE
semantics.MA_response: R = sum_k a_k lit_k evaluated in binary64; public windows carry a LOCAL palette (values present in that window only)
semantics.window: half-open voxel box [o, o+L) with L in {64,128,256}; source containment uses the CLOSED world box [o/1024, (o+L)/1024]

source_domains.global_legal_domain: D(G) = { p in (0,1)^3 : p outside the closed solid, certified clearance(p) > 2^-26 }  (v0.1/v0.2 driver rule, certified)

dataset_prior.SB: S ~ Uniform(D(G)) (uniform proposals in (0,1)^3 conditioned on certified legality); strength 1
dataset_prior.MA: K by campaign schedule (canary: 2,3,4 cycled, i.e. uniform over {2,3,4}); S_1..S_K i.i.d. Uniform(D(G)) conditioned on pairwise distance >= 1/32; a_k i.i.d. U[0.1, 1] (binary64)
dataset_prior.SB_v0.1_release: S ~ Uniform(D(G)) conditioned on the v0.1 coverage-eligibility check (certified globally coverage-ineligible sources resampled, same geometry retained): 3 of 1003 source trials were rejected, all on one geometry that was then dropped; all 1000 published scenes were accepted at their first source trial. Declared as prior tag 'v0.1-coverage-eligible'; models mixing v0.1 and v0.2/v0.3 releases must treat the release as a (known) prior tag

source_domains.geometry_prior: nine certified convex-union families (rind3d.lite_generators), family = slot mod 9 (uniform over families)
source_domains.student_knowledge: the Student sees only the local window; D(G) outside the window is NOT observable, so legality outside the window is not a Student input. Probability mass a Student puts on illegal points is a modelling error measured by the privileged legality oracle, never a label
source_domains.geometry_prior_v0.1: nine families, balanced cyclic over geometry ordinal (111-112 scenes per family in the 1000-scene release)

sb-global-v0.3.target: the true source S (world xyz, float64) - privileged target channel
sb-global-v0.3.prediction_domain: (0,1)^3 (support of the prior: D(G)); the source MAY lie inside the window
sb-global-v0.3.population: natural windows: origin ~ Uniform{0..1024-L}^3 independent of (G,S), side L as declared by the batch
sb-global-v0.3.selection_conditioning: none for the natural profile; selected subsets REQUIRE the population weights w_global (they condition on 'no source in the window', a function of the hidden S)
sb-global-v0.3.source_containing_windows: included (privileged flag contains_source; never a Student input)

training_profiles.mixture: natural + informative + extreme + rare with weight w_global_mixture (population-consistent)

sb-source-excluded-v0.3.declared_condition: the source is OUTSIDE the closed window box; this is a DIFFERENT conditional task p(S | O, W, S not in box(W)) and must be declared to the model (task id / separate head), never mixed silently with sb-global
sb-source-excluded-v0.3.population: natural windows conditioned on no source in the box
sb-source-excluded-v0.3.selection_conditioning: informative / extreme / rare rules are functions of the observation plus the declared condition, so they shift only the input marginal; unweighted training is conditionally consistent, weights w_srcexcl_mixture restore the population input mix
sb-source-excluded-v0.3.source_containing_windows: not samples of this task (weight 0, excluded)

ma-additive-v0.3.target: the unordered set {(S_k, a_k)}_{k=1..K}; K is part of the target (not an input). A known-K variant would be a separate declared conditional task
ma-additive-v0.3.set_semantics: losses and metrics must be permutation invariant; the privileged channel stores the set in lexicographic (x,y,z) order which carries no meaning; Teacher channel order (generation order) is kept only for per-channel physics
ma-additive-v0.3.prediction_domain: (0,1)^3 for every element (global); sources may lie inside the window
ma-additive-v0.3.response_identity: candidate responses are evaluated in the candidate's order; sums of the same strengths in a different order may differ in the last ulp, so comparisons use |R - R_obs| <= 1e-12

evaluation-strata-v0.3.rule: report metrics per stratum; the nonlocal subset is an evaluation/diagnostic stratum only (its rule depends on the hidden first-blocker position, i.e. on geometry and source beyond the observation) and is never part of a training mixture

no_free_windows.flag: privileged no_free and category 0; observable by the Student (all-SOLID input)
no_free_windows.population: kept in the natural population (they are part of it)
no_free_windows.mismatch: undefined: Teacher full/sampled mismatch return status 'no_free' with NaN (strict mode raises NoFreeReceivers); they are excluded from mismatch-based supervision and never scored as zero error

selection_law.index_policy: obs-index-v0.3: per (scene, L, subset) one deterministic uniform proposal stream (v0.2 streams); profiles are prefixes of the same streams (P102 = obs-policy-v0.2 exactly, P256 continues them)

rules.informative: A_inf = mixed over FREE and no source in the closed box
rules.extreme: A_inf and minority fraction <= 0.01 (MA: smallest mixed per-source minority)
rules.nonlocal: A_inf and >= 90% of 32 sampled shadow-FREE receivers have their first blocker towards source 0 outside the box (evaluation only)

selection_law.group_density: q(w) = sum_s (n_s/n) p_nat(w) A_s(w) / P(A_s) inside each (scene, L)

weights.normalisation: self-normalised to mean 1 within each (scene, L); every scene keeps equal mass per side

selection_law.P_estimation: inverse-variance combination of the fixed-design estimate (1024 uniform rate-stream proposals + the natural records) and the unbiased inverse-binomial estimate (r-1)/(n-1) of the subset's own stream
selection_law.privacy: rule indicators, containment flags, proposal indices, acceptance counts and weights are privileged: replaying a public proposal stream reveals which mixed proposals were rejected for containing a source, which localises the source. Release index seeds are HMAC(private 256-bit key, policy, release, scene_id)

window_profiles.hybrid: fixed index (P102 or P256) + deterministic on-demand natural windows: origin = keyed stream HMAC(private dynamic key, scene, epoch, j); flags/weights computed exactly by the trusted loader from CountIndex; never stored
window_profiles.initial_training_profile: see RIND3D_TRAINING_READY_DECISION.md (P256 fixed index for SB; extension pathway = continuation of the same streams or the hybrid dynamic stream)

student.local_coordinates: derived: receiver (i,j,k) of a window at origin o has world centre (o + (i,j,k) + 1/2)/1024

non_features.sample_id: opaque 64-bit join key, HMAC of a private export key; never a model input
non_features.group: opaque 32-bit per-scene token used only by the scene-balanced sampler; never returned in feature batches

student.encoding: SB: packed bits + zstd; MA: local palette + packed code bit planes + zstd; SOLID packed bits + zstd

contents: geometry and oracle references (scene directory, geometry_id)
true sources and strengths (K, canonical set order)
selection rules, indicators, containment, no_free, category, nonlocal estimates
receiver sampling controls and Teacher/Gibbs metadata (via TeacherPhysics v0.3)
privileged.access: trusted training/evaluation process only (directory mode 0700); joined to student samples by sample_id

supervision_routes.A_direct: conditional probability training from privileged ground-truth targets (sources/strengths) with optional population weights; no Teacher calls needed
supervision_routes.B_teacher: selective privileged physical / Gibbs Teacher supervision via TeacherPhysics v0.3 or the Phase 3 adapter, invoked on demand for chosen windows (receiver banks with exact inclusion probabilities); Gibbs precomputation for every window is NOT required by the format
supervision_routes.rule: source truth only ever travels in the privileged target channel; Student input features never contain it

splits: geometry-group split (geometry_split(geometry_id, 0): 80/10/10); separate student export directories per split
seeds: release master seeds, index keys, export keys and dynamic-window keys are private 256-bit secrets (RIND3D_Training_v03/private, mode 0600); the canary uses its public integration seed and is integration data only

releases.canary-v0.3: 216 accepted v0.2 canary scenes, P256 index, two-view export (integration/benchmark)
releases.v0.1-SB-v0.3: 1000 v0.1 SB scenes re-indexed with obs-index-v0.3 and exported (no physics regenerated; v0.1 files untouched); split 776/116/108 (geometry hash); NOTE: the public v0.1 snapshot publishes complete response fields, so its test split is an internal evaluation split, not a blind hidden test for local-only inference
releases.versioning: every release root is new and versioned; v0.1, v0.2 canary and all research outputs are read-only inputs
